summary: BBCMS Mortgage Trust 2026-M1 filed an 8-K on September 21, 2026, reporting an underwriting agreement dated September 17, 2026 for a $653.7 million CMBS issuance closing September 30, 2026. The public certificates total $548.27 million, with $105.41 million in private certificates placed under Section 4(a)(2). Underwriters include Barclays, SG Americas, BMO, Goldman Sachs, Citi, Academy, and Drexel. This is a routine securitization takedown, not a special situation; no deal terms are stated.
